texts.preamble: Ali Reja Osmani vs The State Of Assam And 4 Ors on 31 March, 2023 Author: Sanjay Kumar Medhi Bench: Sanjay Kumar Medhi Page No.# 1/3 Gahc010061972023 The Gauhati High Court (High Court Of Assam, Nagaland, Mizoram And Arunachal Pradesh) Case No. : Wp(C)/1728/2023 Ali Reja Osmani S/O- Late A.F Golam Osmani, R/O- Wajid Manjil, Water Works Road, P.S And P.S- Silchar, Dist- Cachar, Assam, Pin-788801 Versus The State Of Assam And 4 Ors Represented By The Commissioner And Secretary To The Govt. Of Assam. Food Civil Supply And Consumer Affairs Department, Assam Sachibalayala, Dispur, Guwahati 6 2:The Commissioner Food And Drug Administration To The Govt. Of Assam Deparment Of Health And Family Welfare Dispur Guwahati Assam Pin-781006 3:The Deputy Commissioner P.O And P.S- Silchar Dist- Cachar Assam Pin-788001 4:The Designated Officer Ali Reja Osmani vs The State Of Assam And 4 Ors on 31 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/160851483/ 1 Food Safety Cachar Silchar Page No.# 2/3 C/O The Joint Director Health Services Cachar Silchar Assam 5:Food Business Operator/Manufacturer Dds Industries (Bisleri) Jagipara Near Nit Silchar Dist- Cachar Assam Pin-78801 Advocate for the Petitioner : Mr F Z Mazumder Advocate for the Respondent : Ga, Assam Before Honourable Mr. Justice Sanjay Kumar Medhi Order
texts.facts: It is the case of the petitioner that he had detected some foreign particles in a 20 Litre jar of Bisleri mineral water which was accordingly brought to the notice of the authorities by filing the aforesaid complaint as per Section 40 of the Act. It is the case of the petitioner that the jar was sent to the Food Analyst for examination and in the same examination, a Report was issued confirming the allegation of the petitioner. However, the said report was kept in cold storage and not acted upon for almost a year.
